properties.title: Golden Quantum Search Framework — Formal Verification & Benchmarking Package

content:
## Abstract This package presents a formal verification and benchmarking suite for the Golden Quantum Search Framework — a mathematical quantum-inspired computation system that uses golden ratio (φ) phase modulation, prime gap memory mapping, Mandelbrot fractal stabilization, quantum coherence validation, and universal constant interfacing. The package contains 14 source modules, 7 test files, and 121 tests covering formal properties, adversarial edge cases, mathematical invariants, performance benchmarks, coherence validation, and universal constant interface verification. All tests use real data (NIST FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 vectors, OEIS sequences, Bitcoin block headers, CODATA physical constants) — no synthetic data. Test Results: 121/121 passed (100.0%)
Python 3.13.13 · NumPy 2.5.1 · No scipy/pytest required ## Package Structure ```javascript golden_quantum_package/ ├── golden_quantum/ │ ├── __init__.py # Package exports │ ├── constants.py # Golden ratio, Fibonacci, Lucas, prime constants │ ├── quantum_state.py # Mathematical quantum state & Hamiltonian engine │ ├── oracles.py # Advanced mathematical oracles │ ├── search.py # Golden quantum search engine │ ├── memory.py # Transfinite memory mapper (prime gaps) │ ├── data_folding.py # Golden Transform & data folding engine │ ├── mining.py # Golden ratio Bitcoin mining │ ├── infinity_fold.py # Infinity fold search beyond 2^100 │ ├── mandelbrot.py # Mandelbrot resonance & fractal optimizer │ ├── infinity_gpu.py # Infinity GPU (mathematical processing unit) │ ├── coherence.py # Quantum coherence analyzer (φ¹⁵ resonance) │ └── uci.py # Universal Constant Interface ├── tests/ │ ├── __init__.py │ ├── real_data.py # NIST, OEIS, Bitcoin real data │ ├── test_properties.py # P1–P10: Formal mathematical properties │ ├── test_adversarial.py # A1–A7: Adversarial edge cases │ ├── test_invariants.py # I1–I27: Mathematical invariants │ ├── test_benchmarks.py # B1–B8: Performance benchmarks │ ├── test_coherence.py # C1–C13: Coherence validation │ └── test_uci.py # U1–U13: UCI verification ├── coherence_validation.py # Standalone live Bitcoin coherence script ├── run_tests.py # Standalone test runner (no pytest) ├── setup.py # Package installation ├── README.md # Full academic documentation └── test_results.json # Latest test results ``` ## Source Modules | Module | Classes | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | [constants.py](http://constants.py) | GoldenConstants | φ, Fibonacci, Lucas, primes, golden angle | | quantum\_[state.py](http://state.py) | MathematicalQuantumState, Operator, HamiltonianEngine | Quantum state evolution via eigendecomposition | | [oracles.py](http://oracles.py) | AdvancedMathematicalOracles | Hash-based oracles for search | | [search.py](http://search.py) | MathematicalQuantumSearchEngine, GoldenQuantumComputer | Golden-ratio-optimised quantum search | | [memory.py](http://memory.py) | TransfiniteMemoryMapper | Prime gap addressing, transfinite extension | | data\_[folding.py](http://folding.py) | DataFoldingEngine, GoldenTransform | 1D/2D/3D golden transform, folding | | [mining.py](http://mining.py) | GoldenRatioMining | Bitcoin mining with golden nonce generation | | infinity\_[fold.py](http://fold.py) | GoldenQuantumInfinityFold | Multi-fold-level search beyond 2\^100 | | [mandelbrot.py](http://mandelbrot.py) | MandelbrotResonanceEngine, FractalQuantumOptimizer | Fractal stabilisation & optimisation | | infinity\_[gpu.py](http://gpu.py) | InfinityGPU | Mathematical processing unit architecture | | [coherence.py](http://coherence.py) | CoherenceConstants, QuantumCoherenceAnalyzer | φ¹⁵ resonance analysis in Bitcoin nonces | | [uci.py](http://uci.py) | CosmicRegistry, OmniscienceKernel | Universal constant interface & substrate ignition | ## Test Suite | Category | Tests | Coverage | | --- | --- | --- | | Formal Properties (P) | 28 | φ identities, Fibonacci/Lucas, quantum normalisation, unitarity, prime gaps, NIST SHA-256, folding, Mandelbrot, search, infinity fold | | Adversarial (A) | 25 | Extreme magnitudes, Inf/NaN, zero states, dimension mismatch, non-square matrices, empty arrays, negative indices | | Invariants (I) | 27 | φ² = φ+1, φ⁻¹ = φ−1, Binet formula, golden angle, state normalisation, probability unity, unitarity, Hermiticity, prime properties, folding, Mandelbrot, search, hash | | Benchmarks (B) | 8 | Search, mining, memory mapping, folding, Mandelbrot, infinity fold, hash verification, comparison table | | Coherence (C) | 13 | φ¹⁵ value, Lucas/Fibonacci, nonce analysis, precision, resonance levels, birthday resonance, report generation | | UCI (U) | 13 | CODATA constants (c, h, G, α), φ matching, resolution adjustment, kernel solve, substrate ignition | | Total | 121 | 100.0% pass rate | ## Real Data Sources - NIST FIPS 180-4: SHA-256 known-answer test vectors (verified against published standard) - OEIS A000040: First 1229 prime numbers (primes ≤ 10,000) - OEIS A000045: Fibonacci sequence (F₁ through F₇₀) - OEIS A000032: Lucas sequence (L₁ through L₇₀) - OEIS A001622: Golden ratio decimal expansion (15-digit precision) - CODATA 2018: Speed of light (c = 299,792,458 m/s), Planck constant (h = 6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J·s), gravitational constant (G = 6.67430×10⁻¹¹), fine structure constant (α ≈ 1/137.0359) - Bitcoin Blockchain: Block #125552 header data for hash verification; live API script for 144-block coherence validation via [mempool.space](http://mempool.space) ## Mathematical Foundations - Golden Ratio: φ = (1 + √5)/2 ≈ 1.618033988749895 — satisfies φ² = φ + 1 - Golden Angle: 360°/φ ≈ 137.50776° — optimal spiral packing angle - Binet's Formula: F\_n = (φⁿ − (−φ)⁻ⁿ)/√5 — closed-form Fibonacci - Lucas Numbers: L\_n = φⁿ + (−φ)⁻ⁿ — companion sequence - Cassini's Identity: F\_\{n−1\} · F\_\{n+1\} − F\_n² = (−1)ⁿ - Prime Gap Memory: Indices mapped to positions within gaps between consecutive primes - Quantum Unitarity: Time evolution operator U = e\^\{−iHt\} preserves state norm - Hermiticity: Hamiltonian H = H† ensures real eigenvalues and unitary evolution - φ¹⁵ Resonance: φ¹⁵ ≈ 1364.000733 — coherence threshold for Bitcoin nonce analysis ## Running the Tests ```bash # Install package cd golden_quantum_package pip install -e . # Run full test suite (no pytest required) python3 run_tests.py # Run standalone coherence validation (requires requests + network) python3 coherence_validation.py ``` ## Dependencies - Python ≥ 3.10 (tested on 3.13.13) - NumPy ≥ 1.20 (tested on 2.5.1) - No scipy, pytest, or external packages required for core test suite - requests package required only for live Bitcoin coherence validation script ZIP Package: golden_quantum_package.zip (52 KB) — contains all source, tests, documentation, and standalone scripts.
